continuation_schedule: Hold each optimizer at its actual step-20000 learning rate (0.01 times selected initial rate); preserve model, optimizer and RNG states; do not step or restart the old cosine scheduler.
probe_selection: Evenly spaced fixed indices of training data for loss gradients and validation data for layer Jacobians; no test access.
jacobian: Post-ReLU complete hidden layer, including input normalization, actual rectangular rotation map, bias-dependent ReLU mask and active Flow gate. Full singular spectrum and radial response saved for each probe. Also save pre-ReLU spectrum.
interpretation: Exploratory diagnostics and fixed-endpoint-LR continuation sensitivity. Not a new independent test, a proof of convergence, a causal mechanism intervention, or a retuned optimizer comparison.
